priorities.heading: Investing in Education
priorities.quote: Increasing access to affordable childcare through federal subsidies and tax credits, and investing in universal pre-K.

priorities.heading: Rebuilding our Infrastructure
priorities.quote: Delivering investments to the Hudson Valley for critical energy, water, sewer, and transportation infrastructure through direct investments and expanding the federal BRIC (Building Resilient Infrastructure and Communities) grant programs.

priorities.heading: Lowering the Cost of Housing
priorities.quote: Creating a public service housing loan program for teachers, nurses, and first responders to expand access to affordable homeownership in the communities they serve.

cost-of-living.heading: Growing Our Economy for the 21st Century
cost-of-living.quote: Ending entirely the Trump and Lawler-imposed SALT tax cap, which did not exist for over 100 years until Trump instituted it in 2017 to punish New Yorkers, that raises taxes on middle-class New Yorkers and was set to expire, until Lawler voted to make it permanent.

housing.heading: Lowering the Cost of Housing
housing.quote: Creating a public service housing loan program for teachers, nurses, and first responders to expand access to affordable homeownership in the communities they serve.

health-care.heading: Expanding and Protecting Affordable Healthcare
health-care.quote: Allowing everyone to opt in to a public insurance option, regardless of age, expanding coverage, and driving down costs across the marketplace.

immigration.heading: Fixing a Broken Immigration System
immigration.quote: Reining in ICE and restoring accountability, requiring body cameras, standard law enforcement uniforms with visible ID, and prohibiting masked agents.

foreign-policy.heading: Defending Our Interests Abroad
foreign-policy.quote: Ending military escalation with Iran and pursuing diplomacy to ensure Iran never gets a nuclear weapon.

climate-energy.heading: Fighting Climate Change as a National Security Priority
climate-energy.quote: Investing in clean energy, expanding federal investments in solar, wind, and geothermal projects.

priorities.heading: Deliver Real Tax Relief So You Keep More of What You Earn
priorities.quote: Voting for the Working Families Tax Cuts Act that saves the average Hudson Valley family nearly $4,000 this year

priorities.heading: Make Healthcare More Affordable and Accessible
